legend: Mast cell sarcoma of the rib in a 73-year-old male patient. At high magnification, highly polymorphic tumour cells lay in a background of numerous eosinophils; some neoplastic cells present with bilobated nuclei (<<37843>>). The tumour cells show metachromatic granules (Giemsa) (<<37842>>). A pronounced cytoplasmic expression of tryptase was found (<<37841>>). The tumour cells showed a strong membranous expression of KIT (CD117) (<<37840>>), CD25 (<<37839>>), and CD30 (shown here).
